Judgment:
Case of Prosecution:

1. The case of the prosecution is that a complaint was filed by complainant Smt.
Santosh w/o Late Sh.
Ram Niwas r/o Village Kildaudh, Dist. Jhajjar, Haryana under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. by raising the allegation against (1) Parvesh @ Monu and (2) Vicky (both sons of Sohan Lal), (3) Sohan Lal and (4)
Roshini, all resident of VPO Ujwa, New Delhi and (5) Station House Officer PS Jaffarpur Kalan, New State vs . 1. Parvesh Sharma, on 4 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99651573/
1 Delhi with request to register FIR against them.
She in her said complaint stated that "She married her daughter namely Usha with Parvesh i.e. accused No.1 on 08.12.2004 with great pomp and show after taking loan from near and dear one.
She further stated that she had given various articles in the said marriage, out of which most of them were demanded by the accused person.
She further stated that on the very next day of the said marriage, all the accused persons had started demanding dowry from the complainant's daughter.
For this purpose, Usha was subjected to various physical and mental cruelties by the accused persons and some time, accused Parvesh had left Usha at the complainant's house at Jhajjar.

However, the matter was not reported to any police authority with a hope that by the passage of time, every thing will be all right, specifically with accused No. 1 Parvesh and he will accept her daughter.

She further stated that within the first year of marriage, accused No. 1-4 had conspired and had thrown Usha from first floor of her matrimonial house at Ujwa,
however, she survived and sustained grievous injuries.
She further stated that accused persons are greedy and peevish in nature and they never treated Usha as a human being.
Number of Panchayats were organized after the incident of throwing Usha.

2. Moreover, Usha had delivered one child at complainant's house as accused Parvesh had left deceased Usha at her house at the time of her delivery with a threat that in case a girl child is born,
they will not take her back.

Deceased Usha told complainant that accused no.2-3 crossed all the limits of humanity and started making undue and illegal advances and on this, she advised her to discuss this issue with her husband Parvesh.
3.

Thereafter, when Usha talked to Parvesh, she was snubbed by accused No.1 and accused No.1-4 told her that "if she will accede to their demands, she will loose nothing but on the contrary she will be accepted as a family member, will enjoy in every manner and that there will be no more dowry demand by the accused persons from Usha" but Usha refused the same.
Complainant further stated that thereafter, Usha was treated in inhuman manner and cruel behavior by accused No.1-4.
She was not given proper food, cloths etc.

They did not allow Usha to come at her parental home or any other relative from her parental side, also not allowed to talk anyone on mobile or telephone and if any person used to call at her matrimonial home, accused No.1-4 used to abuse the said caller and never allowed him/her to talk to Usha.

4. She further stated that on 09.04.2012, there was function at house of Sh. Anil Kumar (brother of Usha) at parental house of deceased Usha for which complainant and Sh. Anil had folded hands and bowed themselves number of times before accused No.1-4.

The accused No. 3 and 4 had then told complainant and Anil that Usha can visit the said function with accused No.1 only if the complainant or any other relative gives Rs. 50,000/- to him as compensation price of accused No.1 visiting the said function.
The said amount was paid by brother of deceased.
She further submitted that accused No. 4 is black magician (Tantrik).

She further stated that in the said function, Usha met them last and during her talks with her sister Smt. Sushila, she showed apprehension toward her safety and life because of illegal dowry demand from her father and brother by the accused persons and cruel behavior including merciless beatings by accused persons.
But Usha was pacified by complainant and her sister that everything will be alright as the desired amount has been paid to accused No.1.

She further stated that on 08.07.2012 at around 7 a.m., accused No.1 made a call to her and Smt.
Sushila and informed that Usha has expired because of a heart attack.

But some unknown person State vs . 1. Parvesh Sharma, on 4 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99651573/
2 called from Village Ujwa and informed that Usha had not died with heart attack but she has been murdered by accused no. 1-4.
5.
Thereafter, complainant, brother and Sushila and with other relatives rushed to Village Ujwa where a call was made to PCR at 100 number.

She further stated that Smt. Sushila filed a written complaint on 08.07.2012, against accused No.5 (who was SHO and not summoned), who had first arrested accused 1-4 but they were let off for some vested interests and thereafter, complainant filed a complaint to ACP Najafgarh, who accepted the same but refused to give receiving, reasons known to him best.
It is further stated that no article of specimens were preserved by the police officials for forensic examination, though the PM report seems to be procured.
There were other evidences also available at the crime spot against the accused persons but were not collected by police officials.

Apart from that complainant and her relatives were not allowed to see Usha's dead body and it was only after the Media was roped in by complainant's relatives that dead body of Usha was shown to the complainant.
She further stated it is a common practice that no person of village will stand witness against an accused of his own village.

She further stated that because of greedy nature,
sub-standard values, illegal act and conduct, accused persons murdered Usha in most ghastly manner.
She further stated that due to the said act of the accused persons, a young and charming life has been lost.
The accused No.5 and other senior officers did not investigate the matter as per law for the reasons that their palms have been greased and culprits are roaming openly.

She further stated that not only this, accused No.1-4 have also issued threats that in case complainant or her any of the family members pursue the matter at higher level or in Court, then the complainant and each and every of her relative shall be eliminated from this world.
She further stated that accused No.1-4 are guilt of offences u/s 302/304B/498A/120B/506/34 IPC for which they are liable to be tried and punished as per law.
6. The complainant and Smt. Sushila has also filed a complaint before ACP and DCP but police had failed to take any action.
She further stated that police official were trying to show that her daughter Usha had committed suicide instead of taking action against accused No. 1 to 4 and 5.
She further stated that she has no option than to approach the Court."

7. Thereafter, on the abovesaid complaint, Sh.
Vikram, Ld. MM, Dwarka Courts had ordered to register FIR immediately and investigate the matter and to file the compliance report on 08.08.2012.

For the compliance on the abovesaid order,
the case was assigned to Insp. Rajesh Dahyia for investigation and during investigation, Insp. Rajesh Dahiya received seizure memos, crime team report, photographs of the scene of the spot, statement of witnesses dated 08.07.2012, inquest papers including PM Report, MLC from ASI Karan Singh,
who conducted the inquest proceedings till the registration of FIR.

During investigation, on 21.07.2013, accused Parvesh Sharma was arrested after taking the permission from ACP/NJF and also statement of witness i.e. complainant, sister and brother of deceased and of villagers were also recorded.

8. During investigation, sufficient evidence came on record against accused Parvesh Sharma under Section 306/498A IPC but no sufficient evidence come on record against accused persons namely State vs . 1. Parvesh Sharma, on 4 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99651573/
3 Sohan Lal, Roshni Devi and Yogesh and their names were kept in Column No.12 of suspects.
After completion of investigation chargesheet was filed under Sections 306/498A IPC against the accused Parvesh Sharma.

9. It is pertinent to mention here that vide order dated 30.09.2013, accused Sohan Lal, Yogesh and Roshni Devi were summoned by the Court as material or allegations under Section 498A/306 IPC was available on record against the abovesaid accused persons.

10. It is also pertinent to mention here that the counsel for the accused Sohan Lal, Yogesh and Roshni Devi moved revision petition to Ld. Session Court against order dated 498A/306 IPC for summoning them as accused in the present case.

Sh. Vikas Dhull, Ld. ASJ-01, Dwarka Courts had dismissed the revision petition by giving observation that "I do not find any infirmity or illegality committed by Ld. Trial Court in exercising its power to summon revisionists who were shown in column No.12 of the chargesheet.
Revision petition is accordingly dismissed, interim order dated 07.10.2013 stands vacated."

Charges against the accused:
11.

Vide order dated 29.01.2014, the charge for the offences under Section 306/498A/34 IPC was framed against accused Parvesh Sharma, Sohan Lal, Roshni and Yogesh by the Ld. Predecessor to which they pleaded not guilty and claimed trial.

Witnesses examined :
12.

The prosecution examined 23 witnesses in support of its case who are as follows:-
PW1 is Dr. Stanta Das.
He has deposed that on 08.07.2012, he conducted the postmortem on the dead body of deceased.

He further deposed that on 30.10.2012,
he gave subsequent opinion in this case regarding the nature of death on the query of IO whether it was suicidal or homicidal.
He proved PM report Ex.PW1/A. PW2 is HC Sunil Dagar.
He has deposed that on 07.08.2012, he was duty officer and on the direction of the Court u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C. he recorded the FIR No. 87/12 at about 07.20 p.m.
He proved copy of FIR as Ex.PW2/A and his endorsement on the same as Ex.PW2/B. PW3 is HC Bhagwati Prasad.
He has deposed that on 08.07.2012, he was duty officer from 12 mid night to 8 a.m.
He further deposed that in the morning at about 7.43 a.m., he received a call regarding hanging of one girl at village Ujwa and he recorded DD No. 7A.
He proved the DD no. 7A as Ex.PW3/A.
PW4 is Smt. Santosh.
She is the complainant of the present case.
Her testimony shall be considered at later stage.
PW5 is Smt. Sushila.
She is the sister of the deceased and her testimony shall be considered at later stage.
PW6 is Dr. A.S. Yadav.

He has deposed that on 08.07.2012, he examined one lady, brought by Ct.
Anita with the alleged history of hanging and he locally examined her and on checking, the said lady State vs . 1. Parvesh Sharma, on 4 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99651573/
4 was found already expired.
He further deposed that after examination, he mentioned the patient brought dead and advised to shift to mortuary for autospy.

He proved MLC Ex.PW6/A. PW7 is Sh.
Vijay Pal Singh.
He has deposed that after the 7-8 months of the marriage of the daughter of pandit of his village named Usha had been pushed from the roof of the house of the accused persons.

He further deposed that he alongwith 4-5 person of village and also with middle man (bicholia) Sh. Kali Ram, started talking to the accused persons and their other family members and in the said talks,
accused persons stated that due to slip of leg of Usha, she fell down from the roof of their house but Usha told that she was pushed by the accused persons from the roof of their house.
He further deposed that thereafter, on talking to the accused persons, the deceased Usha left to the house of the accused persons as they assured that they will not repeat this act in future.

He further deposed that thereafter, deceased Usha gave a birth to female child, to which some altercation/hot exchange took place between the accused persons and deceased Usha and after again conceiving, accused Parvesh Sharma left deceased Usha at her parental home, where deceased Usha gave a birth to male child in hospital Jhajjar.
He further deposed that after 4-5 days of delivery of male child, accused Parvesh Sharma had taken Usha to his home.
He further deposed that thereafter, he does not know what happened with deceased Usha but he came to know in the village that the daughter of pandit was murdered by accused persons.
PW8 is Sh. Vijay Kumar.
He is the maternal uncle (mama) of the deceased Usha.
He has deposed that in the marriage of deceased Usha, her sister had given sufficient articles and he himself and his other brother had also given her financial aid in the said marriage.
After marriage, Usha was blessed with a daughter and her sister told him that accused Parvesh and his family members were demanding fixed deposit amount.
He further stated that when Usha was blessed with son, accused persons demanded chain, ring and tops of gold.
He further stated that Usha gave birth to a child at the house of his sister and at that time, no one from the family of accused came.
He further deposed that in the year 2010, on the birthday of son of Anil, brother of deceased Usha, accused Parvesh came and Rs. 51,000/- was given to him by his sister in his presence.

He further stated that accused persons harassed Usha and demanded jewellary articles which his sister was unable to fulfill and he and sister tried to make understand the accused Parvesh Sharma not to harass Usha and not to demand articles from his sister.
He further deposed that in the year, 2012 Usha was killed but he do not know by whom, she was killed as he was not present and was in Haridwar on the day of incident.
PW9 is Ct. Arun Kumar.

He has deposed that on 08.07.2012, on the requisition of the local police he reached at the spot at the house of Parvesh i.e. first floor, village Ujwa, Jaffarpur, New Delhi and took 13 photographs of the scene of the spot from different angles and out of which 11 photographs were developed and 2 were washed.
He proved the photographs Ex.PW9/A1 to Ex.PW9/A11 and negatives thereof as Ex.PW9/B1 to Ex.PW9/B11.

He is the brother of the deceased and his testimony shall be considered later on.
PW11 is Lady Ct. Anita.
She has deposed that on 08.07.2012, on receipt of call, she alongwith ASI Karan Singh reached at the spot.
She further deposed about the investigation conducted by him and ASI Karan Singh at the spot and proved Ex.PW11/A. PW12 is Sh. Satish Kumar.

He has deposed that on the same lines as deposed by PW8 is Sh. Vijay Kumar, maternal uncle (mama)

He the proved the Crime Team Report as Ex.PW13/A. PW14 is Kumari Priya.

She has deposed that on 08.07.2012 at about 07.30 a.m., she woke up and could not find her mother at ground floor and on this, she went to her father in a separate premises, where he was fetching milk.
She further deposed that she enquired from her father about her mother and he told him, her mother was at home.
Thereafter, she returned to home and went to upstairs, where room at first floor was bolted from inside, she called his father and he tried to open the same but the same was not opened.

when he went to Milk Dairy of accused Parvesh, he heard some noise of weeping and crying.

He further deposed that after bringing her down, she was laid down on the cot/charpari.

He further deposed that after the adivising of Sh. Ashok Kumar Gupta, accused Praveen pressed her chest and blow air in mouth but there was no movement and thereafter, she brought down in a room at ground floor of the house of accused.
He proved his statement recorded by the police as Ex.PW15/A. PW16 is Sh. Sukhvinder Singh.

she did not complain anything to him.

He further deposed that thereafter, sometime, accused Roshni Devi, mother of accused Parvesh had also come to the dairy and told Parvesh that she was going to fields to take chara for the cows and went.

He further deposed that thereafter, Ms. Priya,
daughter of the accused Parvesh came in the dairy at about 06.10/06.15 a.m., and told that her mother Usha was not opening the door of her room and on this, accused Parvesh and he himself ran towards the house of the accused.

He has deposed that on 08.07.2012 at about 6.25a.m./06.30 a.m., he was standing near chobara of his house and accused Parvesh was shouting and calling him to his house.

6 village were also present there.

He further deposed that accused Parvesh told them that his wife Usha had committed suicide by hanging herself with chunni and he advised him to pump air blow in her mouth so that her heart may start working and accused Parvesh did so but Usha did not respond.

PW19 is HC Om Prakash.

He has deposed that on 08.07.2012, on receipt of DD No. 7A, he alongwith ASI Karan Singh reached at the spot at village Ujwa, New Delhi and deposed about the investigation conducted by ASI Karan Singh at the spot and by the Crime Team.

He proved site plan as Ex.PW19/A, seizure memo of dupatta as Ex.PW11/A and case property i.e. dupatta as Ex.P1.
PW20 SI Karan Singh.

He has deposed that on 08.07.2012, on receipt of DD No.7A, he alongwith Ct.
Om Prakash reached at the spot village Ujwa, New Delhi and many public persons were found gathered there.
He further deposed that dead body of a lady namely Usha was found in a room at ground floor and accused Parvesh Sharma was present there.

He further stated that he seized the dupta and shifted the dead body of the deceased to Mortuary of RTRM Hospital, recorded statement of Ms. Priya, Sh. Jitender, Sh. Sukhbir Singh and Sh. Ashok Kumar, filled death report form, prepared brief facts of the case.

He further deposed that he prepared the seizure memo of jwellary articles of the deceased, which were handed over to him by the doctors and he handed over the same to Smt. Santosh, mother of deceased.

He further deposed that he prepared handing over memo of dead body of deceased and recorded statement of accused Parvesh, Yogesh and Anil Kumar regarding identification of dead body of deceased and another statement of accused Parvesh, which was recorded during the proceedings.

He has proved site plan as Ex.PW19/A, seizure memo of dupatta as Ex.PW11/A, statement of Ms.
Priya, Sh. Jitender, Sh. Sukhbir Singh and Sh. Ashok Kumar as Ex.PW20/A, Ex.PW20/B,
Ex.PW20/C and Ex.PW20/D respectively, death report form as Ex.PW20/E brief facts as Ex.PW20/F, handing over memo of jwellary articles of deceased as Ex.PW20/G, handing over memo of dead body as Ex.PW20/G1, statement of accused Parvesh, Yogesh and Anil Kumar regarding identification of dead body of deceased as Ex.PW20/G2, Ex.PW20/G3 and Ex.PW20/G4 respectively, another statement of accused Parvesh as Ex.PW20/G5 and case property i.e. dupatta as Ex.P1.
PW21 Insp. Ranjeet Dhaka.
He had deposed that on 05.04.2013, the investigation of the present case was taken by him and on 16.07.2013, he obtained permission of the ACP for arrest of accused Parvesh.

He further deposed that on 21.07.2013, he arrested accused Parvesh Sharma, conducted his personal search and recorded statement of witnesses and after completion of the investigation,
filed the chargesheet by keeping accused Roshini Devi, Sohal Lal and Yogesh in column No.12 and accused Parvesh in column No.11.

He proved his application regarding seeking permission of arrest of accused Parvesh as Ex.PW21/A, his arrest memo as Ex.Pw21/B, his personal search as State vs . 1. Parvesh Sharma, on 4 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99651573/
7 Ex.PW21/C. PW22 SI Parveen.

He has deposed that on 21.07.2013, he joined the investigation of the present case with SHO Insp. Ranjeet Dhaka and in his presence, accused Parvesh Sharma was arrested by him, his personal search was conducted.
He proved arrest memo of accused Parvesh Sharma as Ex.PW21/B and his personal search as Ex.PW21/C. PW23 is Insp. Rajesh Dahiya.

He has deposed that on 07.08.2012, he made his endorsement on the complaint of Smt. Santosh after receiving the same at PS from the Court for registration of FIR and taken up the investigation,

also got recorded Statement of Ms. Priya, Sh. Jitender, Sh.
Ashok Kumar and Sh. Sukhbir Singh under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and also take subsequent opinion of the doctor, which was given by Dr. S.Das.
He proved his endorsement as Ex.PW23/A on the complaint, application seeking subsequent opinion of the doctor as Ex.PW23/B and subsequent opinion as Ex.PW23/C.

Thereafter, Prosecution Evidence was closed vide order dated 03.07.2018 on the submissions of the Ld. APP and matter was posted for recording of statement of the accused persons U/s 313 Cr. P. C.
13.

Separate statement of the accused U/s 313 Cr. P. C. was recorded whereby all the incriminating evidence was put to them to which they denied all allegations and pleaded innocence and submitted that they have been falsely implicated in the present case and they never demanded any dowry articles.
They also further submitted that accused Parvesh and deceased Usha were living separately from accused Sohan Lal, Roshni Devi and Yogesh.
They further stated that a false complaint has been filed by PW4 Smt. Santosh at the instance of her daughter Sushila.
14. I have heard the Addl. PP for the State and the counsel for the accused.
The material on record has also been perused.
I have given thoughtful consideration to the arguments addressed by counsel for all the accused persons and Ld. Addl. PP.

15. Ld. APP argued that the case of the prosecution has been duly proved by the prosecution witnesses and also submitted that PW4 Smt. Santosh, PW5 Smt. Sushila and PW10 Sh. Anil supported the case of the prosecution.
They all deposed that about the harassment and cruelty of accused persons and the manner in which deceased Usha was treated by them.

There is a demand of Rs. 51,000/- by the accused persons at the time of the function of the son of PW10 Sh. Anil Kumar,
which was duly supported by the abovesaid witnesses.
16. The counsel for the accused has submitted that accused Parvesh and deceased Usha were residing separately from other accused persons and living happily.
He further stated that there is no demand of dowry at any point of time and accused persons never harassed deceased Usha.
He further stated that there are improvements in the testimony of PW2 Smt. Santosh.

17. The counsel for the accused has relied upon the judgment titles as:
(I) State vs Jitender Garg & Ors., passed by Hon'ble High Court of Delhi dated 21.11.2007 State vs . 1. Parvesh Sharma, on 4 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99651573/

sentences.text:
What the charged offences says:
Section 306 IPC says that:
"If any person commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with imprisonment ..............."

Section 498A IPC says that:
"Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty- Whoever, being the husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty- Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects wuch woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to ........................
Explanation- for the purpose of this section "cruelty" means:
(a) any willful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman; or (b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand."
19.
To prove its case, prosecution had examined PW4 Smt. Santosh (mother of deceased Usha), PW5 Smt. Sushila (sister of deceased Usha), PW7 Sh. Vijay Pal Singh (villager of Smt. Santosh),

Vijay Kumar, PW10 Sh. Anil (brother of deceased Usha), PW12 Sh. Satish Kumar (villager of Smt.
Santosh),
PW14 Kumari Priya (daughter of deceased and accused Parvesh), PW15 Sh. Jitender Kumar (neighbour of accused Parvesh), PW16 Sh. Sukhbir Singh (neighbour of accused Parvesh),

Sh. Ashok Kumar (neighbour of accused Parvesh) and PW18 Sh. Daya Chand (brother in relation).
20.

She further deposed that after the said incident i.e. 3-4 months, her daughter gave a birth to a female child and her mother in law,
father in law and other family members demanded money from her to get FDR of Rs. 3-4 Lacs in the name of newly born female baby.
She further stated in her testimony that accused Yogesh (brother in law of deceased) and Sohan Lal (father in law of deceased) have maltreated her daughter and the State vs .

said fact was stated by her daughter deceased Usha to her but just to save the life of her daughter,

Nobody has seen them murdering the deceased Usha.
Accused Parvesh was living with his wife deceased Usha in a separate house and accused Sohan Lal, Roshni Devi and Yogesh were living separately in another house.
It has come on the record that on listening the noise from the house of accused Parvesh, his fatheraccused Sohan Lal has come and Sh. Ashok went to fields of accused persons to call accused Roshni Devi, who is mother of accused Parvesh.
In these circumstances, burden of proof was heavy on the prosecution to prove on the record such circumstances, which indict father-in-law, mother-in- law and Yogesh and initial presumption against the accused stands discharged.
Resultantly on all counts,
it can be held that prosecution had not proved it case beyond reasonable doubt.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The accused Parvesh, Sohan Lal, Roshni Devi and Yogesh are acquitted for the charge offence.
Bail bonds in terms of Section 437A Cr.P.C.
have already been furnished on behalf of all the accused persons in compliance of the direction of the Court.
The same shall remain in force for a period of six months from today.
